useVehicleLive native-safe reduction (web L9/L23): the web hook opens an SSE EventSource subscription (useRealtimeEvents) and merges live signal frames, hydrating initially from useVehicleLiveSignals. React Native has no EventSource runtime, so the native useVehicleLive hydrates the CONSUMED SUBSET only — { version, swUpdateVersion } parsed from the live-signals query's `Version` / `SoftwareUpdateVersion` fields (flattening `{ value }` envelopes exactly like the web parseSignals) via the already-ported useVehicleLiveSignals(vehicleId) (/signals/{id}/live). The continuous SSE merge is a documented native no-op; the firmware fallback chain still resolves identically because version/swUpdateVersion are populated from the same backend live endpoint.
